title: Payer Sources and Contribution Limits for the Interest Rate Buydown
content:
For each Interest Rate Buydown product, Larkspur Home Lending fixes who may pay for it, which payers' money counts as an interested party contribution, how much Larkspur itself will fund, the largest subsidy relative to the loan amount, when funds are collected and what happens to subsidy funded above the computed amount.

| Product | Who may pay for it | Funding sources counted as interested party contributions | Largest amount Larkspur itself funds | Largest subsidy as a percent of the loan amount | When funds are collected | Subsidy funded above the computed amount refunded to the payer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | borrower, seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | borrower, seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | borrower, seller, builder, Larkspur | seller, builder | $7500.00 | 6.00% | at consummation | Yes |

## Notes on the table

- The borrower appears among the payers of the three permanent products only; the four temporary products list the seller, the builder and Larkspur.
- On every product the seller and the builder are the two funding sources whose money is counted as an interested party contribution. Larkspur and the borrower are not in that list.
- $7500.00 is the largest amount Larkspur itself funds on any one buydown of any of the seven products.
- Funds for every product are collected at consummation.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **Largest subsidy.** On a hypothetical loan amount of $320,000.00, 6.00% of the loan amount is $19,200.00; that is the largest subsidy the product allows on that loan.
- **Larkspur's share.** If Larkspur were the payer on a hypothetical buydown costing $8,000.00, the amount Larkspur itself funds could not go above $7500.00.
- **Overfunding.** If a hypothetical payer deposits more subsidy than the computed amount, the excess is refunded to that payer, since every product shows Yes in the last column.
